receptor_source.structure_name: Human BACE1 in complex with hydroxyethylene peptidomimetic inhibitor 3BN

water_molecules_treatment.protocol_applied: Rigid receptor docking with crystallographic waters removed
water_molecules_treatment.rationale: Standard rigid-receptor AutoDock Vina v1.2.7 requires removal of non-polar hydrogens and waters unless using hydrated flexible-water protocols.

catalytic_dyad_protonation_states.inter_dyad_distance: ASP32_OD1 to ASP228_OD1 distance = 2.922 A (shared catalytic proton bridge)

state_1_deprot.name: Standard Deprotonated Dyad (deprot)
state_1_deprot.description: Default AutoDockTools lookup state where both Asp32 and Asp228 carry unprotonated carboxylates.

state_2_ash32.name: Asp32 Monoprotonated (ash32)
state_2_ash32.description: Asp32 OD1 carries explicit neutral hydrogen HD1 (pointing toward Asp228 OD1 at 2.92 A bridge), leaving OD2 as carbonyl acceptor.

state_3_ash228.name: Asp228 Monoprotonated (ash228)
state_3_ash228.description: Asp228 OD1 carries explicit neutral hydrogen HD1 (pointing toward Asp32 OD1 at 2.92 A bridge), leaving OD2 as carbonyl acceptor.

docking_grid_box.definition_method: Centroid of co-crystallized reference ligand 3BN in 2B8V
